# probe used in game (te_debug_tax_effects.txt: `type = amendment_type:<key>`).
# te_tax_amendment_is_<key>: the amendment is one of that instrument's family.
# te_tax_amendment_matches_<key>: it is the one the country's enacted index names.
# The match reads scope:te_tax_country, which the caller saves first
# (te_tax_sync_collection does).

		AND = { type = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_cons_1 scope:te_tax_country.var:te_tax_en_cons = 1 }
		AND = { type = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_cons_2 scope:te_tax_country.var:te_tax_en_cons = 2 }
		AND = { type = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_cons_3 scope:te_tax_country.var:te_tax_en_cons = 3 }
		AND = { type = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_cons_4 scope:te_tax_country.var:te_tax_en_cons = 4 }
		AND = { type = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_cons_5 scope:te_tax_country.var:te_tax_en_cons = 5 }
		AND = { type = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_cons_6 scope:te_tax_country.var:te_tax_en_cons = 6 }
		AND = { type = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_cons_7 scope:te_tax_country.var:te_tax_en_cons = 7 }
		AND = { type = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_cons_8 scope:te_tax_country.var:te_tax_en_cons = 8 }
		AND = { type = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_cons_9 scope:te_tax_country.var:te_tax_en_cons = 9 }
		AND = { type = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_cons_10 scope:te_tax_country.var:te_tax_en_cons = 10 }
		AND = { type = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_cons_11 scope:te_tax_country.var:te_tax_en_cons = 11 }
		AND = { type = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_cons_12 scope:te_tax_country.var:te_tax_en_cons = 12 }
	}
}

# Slot a, country scope: the package touches at least one catalog good.
te_tax_gen_package_touches_goods_a = {
	OR = {
		var:te_tax_pa_g_aeroplanes >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_automobiles >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_clippers >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_clothes >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_coal >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_coffee >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_consumer_appliances >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_digital_access >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_digital_assets >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_electricity >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_fabric >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_fine_art >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_fish >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_fruit >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_furniture >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_glass >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_grain >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_groceries >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_liquor >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_luxury_clothes >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_luxury_furniture >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_meat >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_oil >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_opium >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_paper >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_porcelain >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_radios >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_services >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_silk >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_small_arms >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_steamers >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_sugar >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_tea >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_telephones >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_tobacco >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_tourism >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_transportation >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_wine >= 0
		var:te_tax_pa_g_wood >= 0
	}
}

# Slot a, country scope: every provision group the package touches still has the
# external-change token it had at approval. Only a non-legislative change bumps
# te_tax_xver_*, so expected sunsets and other packages never make it stale.
te_tax_gen_package_current_a = {
	OR = {
		var:te_tax_pa_wage < 0
		var:te_tax_pa_xver_wage = var:te_tax_xver_wage
	}
	OR = {
		var:te_tax_pa_div < 0
		var:te_tax_pa_xver_div = var:te_tax_xver_div
	}
	OR = {
		var:te_tax_pa_land < 0
		var:te_tax_pa_xver_land = var:te_tax_xver_land
	}
	OR = {
		var:te_tax_pa_head < 0
		var:te_tax_pa_xver_head = var:te_tax_xver_head
	}
	OR = {
		var:te_tax_pa_cons < 0
		var:te_tax_pa_xver_cons = var:te_tax_xver_cons
	}
	OR = {
		NOT = { te_tax_gen_package_touches_goods_a = yes }
		var:te_tax_pa_xver_goods = var:te_tax_xver_goods
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			var:te_tax_pa_agrel < 0
			var:te_tax_pa_regrel < 0
		}
		var:te_tax_pa_xver_relief = var:te_tax_xver_relief
	}
}

# Country scope: every sunset in the bill falls at least one month after commencement.
# te_tax_store_package writes _exp = te_tax_bl_due + te_tax_bl_<key>_sun, so _exp >= _due + 1
# exactly when the offset is at least 1; 0 means no sunset; an untouched provision
# (-1) has none.
te_tax_gen_bill_sunsets_valid = {
	OR = {
		var:te_tax_bl_wage < 0
		var:te_tax_bl_wage_sun = 0
		var:te_tax_bl_wage_sun >= 1
	}
	OR = {
		var:te_tax_bl_div < 0
		var:te_tax_bl_div_sun = 0
		var:te_tax_bl_div_sun >= 1
	}
	OR = {
		var:te_tax_bl_land < 0
		var:te_tax_bl_land_sun = 0
		var:te_tax_bl_land_sun >= 1
	}
	OR = {
		var:te_tax_bl_head < 0
		var:te_tax_bl_head_sun = 0
		var:te_tax_bl_head_sun >= 1
	}
	OR = {
		var:te_tax_bl_cons < 0
		var:te_tax_bl_cons_sun = 0
		var:te_tax_bl_cons_sun >= 1
	}
}

# Draft, bill and passage (docs/systems/tax_code_schema.md, "Draft, bill and passage").
# Country scope. Each reads a record's payload, so callers test te_tax_draft_active /
# te_tax_bill_active (te_tax_triggers.txt) first.

# The draft changes at least one provision.
te_tax_gen_draft_touches_any = {
	OR = {
		var:te_tax_dr_wage >= 0
		var:te_tax_dr_div >= 0
		var:te_tax_dr_land >= 0
		var:te_tax_dr_head >= 0
		var:te_tax_dr_cons >= 0
		te_tax_gen_draft_touches_goods = yes
		var:te_tax_dr_agrel >= 0
		var:te_tax_dr_regrel >= 0
	}
}

# Every provision the draft changes still has the planned version it had when first
# touched (te_tax_cmd_draft_rebase acknowledges a change).
te_tax_gen_draft_baseline_current = {
	OR = {
		var:te_tax_dr_wage < 0
		var:te_tax_dr_wage_pver = var:te_tax_pver_wage
	}
	OR = {
		var:te_tax_dr_div < 0
		var:te_tax_dr_div_pver = var:te_tax_pver_div
	}
	OR = {
		var:te_tax_dr_land < 0
		var:te_tax_dr_land_pver = var:te_tax_pver_land
	}
	OR = {
		var:te_tax_dr_head < 0
		var:te_tax_dr_head_pver = var:te_tax_pver_head
	}
	OR = {
		var:te_tax_dr_cons < 0
		var:te_tax_dr_cons_pver = var:te_tax_pver_cons
	}
	OR = {
		NOT = { te_tax_gen_draft_touches_goods = yes }
		var:te_tax_dr_goods_pver = var:te_tax_pver_goods
	}
}

# The draft differs from the bill in any field.
te_tax_gen_draft_differs_from_bill = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_due = var:te_tax_bl_due }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_wage = var:te_tax_bl_wage }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_wage_sun = var:te_tax_bl_wage_sun }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_div = var:te_tax_bl_div }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_div_sun = var:te_tax_bl_div_sun }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_land = var:te_tax_bl_land }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_land_sun = var:te_tax_bl_land_sun }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_head = var:te_tax_bl_head }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_head_sun = var:te_tax_bl_head_sun }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_cons = var:te_tax_bl_cons }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_cons_sun = var:te_tax_bl_cons_sun }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_aeroplanes = var:te_tax_bl_g_aeroplanes }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_automobiles = var:te_tax_bl_g_automobiles }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_clippers = var:te_tax_bl_g_clippers }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_clothes = var:te_tax_bl_g_clothes }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_coal = var:te_tax_bl_g_coal }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_coffee = var:te_tax_bl_g_coffee }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_consumer_appliances = var:te_tax_bl_g_consumer_appliances }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_digital_access = var:te_tax_bl_g_digital_access }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_digital_assets = var:te_tax_bl_g_digital_assets }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_electricity = var:te_tax_bl_g_electricity }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_fabric = var:te_tax_bl_g_fabric }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_fine_art = var:te_tax_bl_g_fine_art }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_fish = var:te_tax_bl_g_fish }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_fruit = var:te_tax_bl_g_fruit }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_furniture = var:te_tax_bl_g_furniture }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_glass = var:te_tax_bl_g_glass }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_grain = var:te_tax_bl_g_grain }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_groceries = var:te_tax_bl_g_groceries }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_liquor = var:te_tax_bl_g_liquor }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_luxury_clothes = var:te_tax_bl_g_luxury_clothes }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_luxury_furniture = var:te_tax_bl_g_luxury_furniture }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_meat = var:te_tax_bl_g_meat }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_oil = var:te_tax_bl_g_oil }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_opium = var:te_tax_bl_g_opium }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_paper = var:te_tax_bl_g_paper }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_porcelain = var:te_tax_bl_g_porcelain }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_radios = var:te_tax_bl_g_radios }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_services = var:te_tax_bl_g_services }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_silk = var:te_tax_bl_g_silk }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_small_arms = var:te_tax_bl_g_small_arms }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_steamers = var:te_tax_bl_g_steamers }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_sugar = var:te_tax_bl_g_sugar }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_tea = var:te_tax_bl_g_tea }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_telephones = var:te_tax_bl_g_telephones }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_tobacco = var:te_tax_bl_g_tobacco }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_tourism = var:te_tax_bl_g_tourism }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_transportation = var:te_tax_bl_g_transportation }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_wine = var:te_tax_bl_g_wine }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_g_wood = var:te_tax_bl_g_wood }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_agrel = var:te_tax_bl_agrel }
		NOT = { var:te_tax_dr_regrel = var:te_tax_bl_regrel }
	}
}

# Every provision group the bill touches still has the external version it had when the
# bill was introduced: nothing outside legislation changed it since.
te_tax_gen_bill_current = {
	OR = {
		var:te_tax_bl_wage < 0
		var:te_tax_bl_xver_wage = var:te_tax_xver_wage
	}
	OR = {
		var:te_tax_bl_div < 0
		var:te_tax_bl_xver_div = var:te_tax_xver_div
	}
	OR = {
		var:te_tax_bl_land < 0
		var:te_tax_bl_xver_land = var:te_tax_xver_land
	}
	OR = {
		var:te_tax_bl_head < 0
		var:te_tax_bl_xver_head = var:te_tax_xver_head
	}
	OR = {
		var:te_tax_bl_cons < 0
		var:te_tax_bl_xver_cons = var:te_tax_xver_cons
	}
	OR = {
		NOT = { te_tax_gen_bill_touches_goods = yes }
		var:te_tax_bl_xver_goods = var:te_tax_xver_goods
	}
	OR = {
		AND = { var:te_tax_bl_agrel < 0 var:te_tax_bl_regrel < 0 }
		var:te_tax_bl_xver_relief = var:te_tax_xver_relief
	}
}

# Every provision the bill changes moves at most two steps from existing law (minor bill).
te_tax_gen_bill_small_steps = {
	OR = {
		var:te_tax_bl_wage < 0
		AND = { te_tax_bl_dstep_wage <= 2 te_tax_bl_dstep_wage >= -2 }
	}
	OR = {
		var:te_tax_bl_div < 0
		AND = { te_tax_bl_dstep_div <= 2 te_tax_bl_dstep_div >= -2 }
	}
	OR = {
		var:te_tax_bl_land < 0
		AND = { te_tax_bl_dstep_land <= 2 te_tax_bl_dstep_land >= -2 }
	}
	OR = {
		var:te_tax_bl_head < 0
		AND = { te_tax_bl_dstep_head <= 2 te_tax_bl_dstep_head >= -2 }
	}
	OR = {
		var:te_tax_bl_cons < 0
		AND = { te_tax_bl_dstep_cons <= 2 te_tax_bl_dstep_cons >= -2 }
	}
}

# Slot a's package touches a provision the bill touches. Read only while it is on.
te_tax_gen_bill_overlaps_a = {
	OR = {
		AND = { var:te_tax_bl_wage >= 0 var:te_tax_pa_wage >= 0 }
